comparison.objective: Return a comb frame to a honey super and slide it against neighboring frames.
comparison.physical_skill: Large-frame lifting, bilateral lug placement, alignment onto rests, and lateral seating.
comparison.success_condition: Both lugs supported, frame level/square/centered, neighbor gap at most 2 mm, other frames undisturbed, and grippers released.
comparison.reason: This is support placement and sliding of a large intact frame. It lacks tool-mediated impact, fracture, small retained-insert protection, and released-fragment recovery.
